page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.6xlarge is a compute-optimized x86_64 server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. The instance is built around a dedicated 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor containing 12 physical cores and 24 virtual CPUs running 2 threads per core. System memory is provisioned at 48.0 GB, establishing a 2.0 GB RAM allocation per vCPU. The CPU architecture includes 48 KB of L1d cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of L3 cache per socket, alongside vector instructions including AVX, AVX-512, and AVX512_VNNI. Cryptographic hardware acceleration is supported through AES, VAES, and SHA_NI instructions. The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps and includes zero local SSD storage and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark testing positions the ecs.c7t.6xlarge primarily in the average performance tier across general compute and memory workloads. The instance registered a single-core stress-ng CPU score of 1892.79 and a multi-core score of 23333.53, alongside a Geekbench multi-core rating of 12002.0. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth reached 129.2 GB/sec, while write operations measured 62.95 GB/sec. Application testing yielded a Redis throughput of 23.57 million SET operations per second and a static web serving throughput of 27.72 GB/sec. In small-model language processing (135M parameters), text generation achieved a strong result in the top quartile at 295.58 tokens per second, while prompt processing reached 1861.58 tokens per second.

The instance demonstrates high resource density for CPU-heavy tasks due to its 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio. The absence of integrated local block storage requires reliance on cloud network volumes, which introduces potential IOPS tradeoffs for IO-intensive operations. Given its dedicated core allocation, AVX-512 vector support, and baseline networking speed, Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.6xlarge provides cost-efficient operation for software compilation (Geekbench compile score 21392.0), web application serving, Redis caching nodes, and small-model CPU inference.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.6xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized server instance based on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by a dedicated 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor, it offers 12 physical cores, 24 vCPUs, and 48 MB of L3 cache. Hardware acceleration features include AVX-512, AES, and SHA_NI instruction sets. The instance includes 48.0 GB of memory (2.0 GB per vCPU) and a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. No local storage or discrete GPUs are attached. Benchmarks indicate solid middle-tier performance across multi-core compute, static web serving (27.72 GB/sec), and Redis operations (23.57 million SET ops/sec), with strong results in small-model text generation (295.58 tokens/sec). The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio supports workloads such as software compilation, API endpoints, web serving, and lightweight machine learning inference.
